native_adapters.release_gates: P01-T01 and P02 actual bindings, offline assets, engine failures and native target qualification

crypto.build: Vendored C library through locked cc1.4.6; native C compiler required
crypto.license: CC0-1.0 wrapper and MIT vendored libsecp256k1; notices retained in dependency sources
crypto.features: std/alloc; no rand, recovery or fuzz crypto selected; clean builder strips ambient rustflags

tls.features: Explicit ring provider; rustls std/ring/tls12; no native-certs, webpki-roots or dangerous verifier
tls.qualified_scope: Explicit PostgreSQL migration consumer: native Linux amd64 TLS1.3 and CA/server-name/client-certificate positive and negative cases at ffb94a8. Rotation/revocation, arbitrary provider matrices, native arm64 network acceptance and full release remain unqualified.

rocks.license_selection: Apache-2.0 for the inspected Rust binding headers and the dual-licensed RocksDB engine; retain LevelDB BSD-3-Clause and xxHash BSD-2-Clause notices as well as the complete applicable upstream notices.

compression.license_selection: BSD option for the dual-licensed native Zstandard code; preserve both wrapper and generated-binding notices.

rocks.lock_graph_boundary: bzip2-sys 0.1.13+1.0.8 and libz-sys 1.1.29 appear in Cargo.lock but are absent from the selected normal/build graphs for aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu and aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu. The static feature references them with optional dependency forwarding; it does not activate them.
rocks.build: Compile bundled RocksDB C++20 and Zstandard C sources using the selected CC/CXX/AR and the platform C++ standard library. Build-time bindgen dynamically loads libclang; it is not an application runtime libclang dependency. Clean builds exclude ambient native overrides, prebuilt ROCKSDB_LIB_DIR and ZSTD_SYS_USE_PKG_CONFIG; no system engine substitution is selected.

build_dependencies.name: clang-sys
build_dependencies.features: runtime plus clang_11_0 and its implied older API features

rocks.toolchain_receipt: tools/build.py records canonical compiler/archiver/libclang paths, exact versions and SHA-256 values, selected macOS SDK identity and the environment actually passed to the build. CARGO_BUILD_JOBS defaults to 2; native toolchain preparation is explicit on all selected CI runners.
rocks.qualification_scope: Exact source/license and active feature-graph inspection only in this inventory update. Candidate Mac engine tests and historical isolated binding experiments retain their own evidence. Native Linux product builds, failure/recovery workloads, admission/replay, cross-store authority and full release qualification are not established by this record.

archive.build: Exact hashed official library and header via explicit DUCKDB_LIB_DIR/DUCKDB_INCLUDE_DIR; no bundled C++ compilation, implicit system library or upstream downloader selected. The upstream crate still compiles its unconditional downloader/decompression build dependencies.
archive.runtime: Separate unpublished finite worker executable; signed checksum-pinned ducklake, postgres_scanner and httpfs assets; autoload/autoinstall/unsigned/community extension options disabled. Ordinary application does not depend on this package.
archive.qualification_scope: Initial Mac diagnostic and six scoped native unit cases only; exact-revision Linux worker, parent supervision, typed scientific rows, PostgreSQL catalog persistence, S3, full release and native Linux arm64 remain unqualified.

license_policy: New project code is MIT. Preserve upstream notices and qualify the complete release SBOM/licenses when dependencies and assets are added. This inventory is not a complete release license audit.
